//: HiDPI variants of the system's art, for tools/hidpi-art.py: name@2x.png and name@3x.png beside each name.png.
The top level is the shell's Open webOS art (shell/assets/openwebos); `sets` are other art: the Phoenix apps' kit,
the original apps', frameworks' and system UI's art in third_party/, and Phoenix apps' own pictures. `art`: the
directory of the 1x files; `devices`: the device paths it is served at (runtime/rootfs.json), whose compat
overlay directories get the variants (else they go beside the art).
original: a variant copied from art Open webOS / Enyo already ship at that size (from: its path in that
repository, checked out under --ref; repo: where it is).
upscale: art shipped at 1x only, enlarged to `factors` (default above), corrected so it scales back down to
the 1x art (back-projection). `method`: model (default; Real-ESRGAN, the model below, 4x: icons, glyphs,
pictures), smooth (bicubic: gradients, shadows, masks, panels, key tiles; no grain), pixel (each pixel a
square: patterns drawn a pixel at a time), downscale (from `source`, a larger drawing of the same picture),
copy (the variants of `from`, the same picture elsewhere in the repository). `source` (model, smooth): a larger
drawing to enlarge instead of the 1x art (Enyo's 1.5x art where it is exactly 1.5 times the 1x art and true
to it). `tiles`: [columns, rows] of a sprite sheet, enlarged one cell at a time so the cells do not bleed into
each other (`split`: x, y or xy, at the clear rows between cells of different sizes). `wrap`: x, y or xy for
tiled art. `from` (model, smooth): enlarge that variant (an original, beside the others) instead.
derived: variants another tool writes (checked here). skip: left at 1x, each with its reason.
css: stylesheets whose url()s of art with variants must be image sets of them all. rewrite-css: the set's
stylesheets (relative to `art`) the system loads; each that names art with variants gets a copy in the compat
overlay at every device path, asking for them with image sets.
See docs/spec/hidpi-art.md and shell/assets/openwebos/PROVENANCE.md.
